final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS player_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id COLLATE BINARY = ma.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, player_count, CAST(player_count AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(player_count) FROM hand_counts), 0) AS share FROM hand_counts WHERE (SELECT SUM(player_count) FROM hand_counts) IS NOT NULL), above_average AS (SELECT player_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess FROM shares WHERE (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) IS NOT NULL AND share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_average
